run_evaluation_cli: run the evaluation script comparing ground truth and predicted images using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS metrics
run_lightfield_evaluation: run the evaluation in lightfield mode to compare 17x17 lightfield view images excluding every 4th row and column
run_gamma_corrected_evaluation: run the evaluation with gamma correction applied to both ground truth and predicted images before computing metrics
run_elpips_evaluation: run the evaluation using E-LPIPS instead of standard LPIPS for perceptual image quality comparison
run_same_dir_evaluation: run the evaluation in same_dir mode to compare ground truth and predicted images from a single directory
